Stored hosts are not normalized to lowercase (the validation regex uses `/i`, permitting mixed case), so a stored 'EvilTrout.com' or an uppercase referer host like 'EVILTROUT.COM' would fail to match. The mechanism is verifiable in the diff and is a real defect.

adjudication.rationale: In `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host`, the lookup is `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` using `host = uri.host` without explicitly downcasing the RHS. That is an inconsistency visible in the diff and could be an edge-case if `uri.host` ever preserves mixed case, but the diff alone doesn’t prove mixed-case referers will fail (Ruby’s URI parser often normalizes host casing). This is thus a robustness/clarity concern rather than a clearly verifiable defect from the diff.
